positive_tests: After arbiter applies the migration, node test-global-analytics-rpc.mjs calls get_global_analytics_data(8, 2026) with the anon key and exits 0 with a row count.
negative_tests: Before migration apply, node test-global-analytics-rpc.mjs fails with 'Could not find the function public.get_global_analytics_data(p_month, p_year) in the schema cache' and exits 1.

findings.evidence: Studied baseline RPC public.get_employee_financials: SECURITY INVOKER, companies.tax_rate_clt/tax_rate_prolabore by contract_type, granted to anon/authenticated/service_role. New RPC mirrors this pattern.
Migration uses CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION, SET search_path = public, pg_temp, rollback comment, additive, OWNER TO postgres plus grants matching existing financeiro RPC.

Schema-driven assumptions documented in migration comments: employee_benefits has no month columns so active benefits summed as recurring; employee_uniforms/uniform_items have no unit price so uniform_cost is 0; absences inferred from time_logs rows with all NULL punch times; termination estimate simplified to base_salary + encargos.
Migration not applied locally; final PASS depends on arbiter running supabase db push and rerunning the test.

remaining_risks: Migration must be applied by the arbiter; implementer did not run supabase db push.
uniform_cost hardcoded to 0 because schema stores quantity_delivered but no unit price.
Benefit costs not filtered by month because employee_benefits lacks month/year columns.
Absence detection assumes a time_logs row with NULL punch times is an absence.
Termination estimate is a simplified base_salary + encargos proxy.
